integrity: The source Hamiltonian, target class, conservation law, paired-block construction, parity endpoint, and first public date were checked against arXiv:2609.32845v1. The lower bound is reconstructed from the model rather than inferred from the source authors' efficiency claim. The finite checker is supplemental and is not used as an infinite proof.
limitations: The theorem measures quantum-field segments only within the ideal alternating Luo--Yu Hamiltonian architecture. It does not cover simultaneous classical-plus-quantum driving, higher-order multiphoton couplings, larger ancillas, noisy control, minimum physical runtime, or minimum total laboratory pulse count.
title: Exact quantum-field segment depth for qutrit-assisted cavity-state synthesis
